page.overview:
Who is Guard Commander Eel?

When Sun Wukong came to the Dragon Palace of the East Sea in search of a weapon, Ao Guang had Colonel Mackerel and Guard Commander Eel bring him a nine-pronged spear weighing 3,600 pounds, but Sun Wukong found it too light.

Category:Gods Category:Males Category:Attendants of Ao Guang
